preflight.train_time_score_semantics: The canonical trainer builds only feature differences x(hi)-x(lo) and mirrored negatives, with binary labels 1/0. The model outputs P(ordered first action outranks second action) for a pair relation. No individual train-time action scalar s(a) or s(b) is defined or optimized.
preflight.blocking_reason: The frozen sklearn HistGradientBoostingClassifier exposes fixed binary log_loss during fit and accepts only ordinary sample_weight. It has no custom per-example loss/gradient API to implement softplus(m-y*z) only for mirrored BN rows while retaining m=0 for BH/NH. The canonical architecture learns a pairwise probability from x(a)-x(b), not an identifiable train-time scalar difference s(a)-s(b); its inference action score is a later MEAN of pairwise probabilities. Therefore the requested m=0.05 cannot be placed exactly on a verified equivalent train-time s(a)-s(b) scale.
